headline: National Pepper Smuggling Conference Declared a Success as State Bureaucracies Confiscate Soothing Beige Muffins
deck: As authorities respond with 'Zero Tolerance' policies, citizens by the dozen find their muffin options dwindling to despair.
article:
In a groundbreaking announcement this week, the Department of Spice Enforcement hailed the National Pepper Smuggling Conference as a monumental success. Attendees, clad in beige, gathered to celebrate the underground spice trade that has quietly flourished in America’s culinary scene. Authorities seized complimentary beige muffins upon discovering they contained a trace of pepper—an egregious violation of the state's stringent spice regulations.

'We simply cannot allow such an affront to our culinary integrity,' declared Deputy Spice Czar Harold Grindelstein at a press conference, flanked by salt shakers and stern warnings about illegal spices. The newly minted 'Zero Tolerance' policy has led to a nationwide prohibition on muffin-related activities, with offenders now facing fines up to $1,000 for even the tiniest crumb of spice-related evidence.

In a related twist, local law enforcement reported a staggering 300% increase in traffic stops, with officers zealously inspecting vehicles for suspicious containers labeled as 'cumin' and 'paprika.' This uptick in petty crime has prompted municipalities to consider deploying spice-sniffing drones, a move many residents believe will further infringe on their privacy as the hunt for contraband spices escalates.

'If we can stop just one muffin from contaminating our society, then it’s worth it,' proclaimed local resident and self-styled Spice Crusader Janet B. Nausea. As citizens ponder whether America can survive in this spice-free reality, the future appears more beige than ever.
author: Evelyn Saltman, Spice Correspondent

oped.title: Muffin Crisis: A Tragedy of Beige and Hat-Related Misfortune
oped.author: Sir Percival Whiskertop, PhD in Muffinology
oped.body: Ah, the National Pepper Smuggling Conference—a triumph of bureaucracy over breakfast delights! While the government flounders in a sea of beige, citizens lament their muffin drought. But let us not overlook the heinous culprits: those unfashionable hats! Yes, the very hats that seemingly adorn the heads of every disheartened citizen are to blame. I propose a national ban on hats! It would save our muffins and restore order amid this pepper scandal. Imagine a world where all citizens are hatless, free to enjoy their bland pastries without the pesky distraction of headwear! A return to classic bald-headed dignity! Why risk pepper smuggling when we can eradicate the real threat? Let us channel our despair into a glorious, hat-free revolution, for only then will we reclaim our rightful place in the beige culinary pantheon! Down with hats, up with muffins!

classifieds.text: Desperate times call for desperate measures! Selling my entire stash of gourmet beige ingredients—instant mashed potatoes, powdered gravy, and a lifetime supply of salt. Perfect for those wishing to stockpile before the authorities catch on!

Wanted: Expert muffin bakers willing to work *under the table* to create beige delights sans pepper! Pay in crackers, and you’ll gain exclusive access to *my secret* spice stash! Serious inquiries only—must know how to dodge raids!

To all citizens of Beigeville, please be advised that due to the recent confiscation of muffin supplies, a citywide muffin mourning ceremony will be held this Friday at the Saltless Salt Flats. Bring your beige attire and your best salt puns!

panels.caption: So. National Pepper Smuggling Conference Declared a Success.

stories.headline: Local Team Wins, Loses, or Draws
stories.article:
The match unfolded despite the National Pepper Smuggling Conference's triumphant announcement, which the referee ruled was not part of his jurisdiction.

The final score is currently under review by a committee. Fans celebrated anyway, on principle.

stories.headline: Beloved Institution Dies Doing What It Loved: Persisting
stories.article:
After years of dignified irrelevance, it finally succumbed, survived only by its extensive paperwork.

In lieu of flowers, the family requests you simply move along, as it would have wanted.
